question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(AB=AC=10\) and \(BC=12\). Circle \(A\) is drawn with center \(A\) and is tangent to line \(BC\). Find the radius of circle \(A\).

solutions.explanation: Draw \(AD\perp BC\). Then \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\), \(BD=6\), and \(AD=\sqrt{10^2-6^2}=8\). The distance from the center to \(BC\) equals the radius, so the radius is 8.
solutions.title: Altitude and center-to-line distance
